themes.note: Frontmatter colours are dark-theme values. The light theme remaps the zone ramp and rules to paper; the OSD strip (osd-*) and drop-down menus stay black glass; the page rail follows the theme. Accent is swappable; amber is the default.

components.css: .ds-osd-strip{background:#08090a;padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #eceae51f} .ds-osd{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;height:28px;padding:0 12px 0 4px;border-radius:4px;background:#0e0f11;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #eceae51f;color:#9a9ea5;font-family:'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;font-size:10px;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:.02em;white-space:nowrap} .ds-tally{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:20px;padding:0 8px;border-radius:3px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#6b7079;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out} .ds-lamp{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor} .ds-run{color:#ffb020} .ds-rec{background:#ff3b30;color:#fff} .ds-rec .ds-lamp{animation:ds-blink 1s steps(1,end) infinite} @keyframes ds-blink{50%{opacity:0}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-rec .ds-lamp{animation:none}} .ds-tc{color:#eceae5;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em} .ds-field{display:inline-flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px;padding-left:14px;border-left:1px solid #eceae51f} .ds-v{color:#eceae5} .ds-u{color:#6b7079;text-transform:uppercase}

components.css: .ds-rail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;width:76px;padding:4px;background:#08090a;border-right:1px solid #eceae514} .ds-rail-tab{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:8px 2px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:#9a9ea5;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out,color 120ms ease-out} .ds-rail-tab svg{opacity:.72} .ds-rail-tab:hover,.ds-sel{background:#1b1d21;color:#eceae5} .ds-rail-tab:hover svg,.ds-sel svg{opacity:1} .ds-rail-tab:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #ffb020;outline-offset:1px} .ds-sel::before,.ds-sel::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:7px;height:7px;border:0 solid #ffb020;pointer-events:none} .ds-sel::before{top:0;left:0;border-top-width:2px;border-left-width:2px;border-top-left-radius:4px} .ds-sel::after{right:0;bottom:0;border-right-width:2px;border-bottom-width:2px;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}

components.name: Transport

components.css: .ds-transport{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px;background:#141619;border:1px solid #eceae514;border-radius:4px} .ds-key,.ds-play{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:28px;height:28px;border:1px solid #eceae526;border-radius:4px;background:#1b1d21;color:#c9cbcf;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out,color 120ms ease-out} .ds-key:hover{background:#30343a;color:#eceae5} .ds-play{width:36px;border-color:transparent;background:#ffb020;color:#1a1200} .ds-play:hover{background:#ffcf6b} .ds-key:focus-visible,.ds-play:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #ffb020;outline-offset:1px} .ds-stop{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:1px;background:currentColor} .ds-clock{margin-left:auto;font-family:'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#eceae5} .ds-clock span{color:#6b7079;font-weight:400}

components.css: .ds-tiles{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:8px;background:#0e0f11} .ds-tile{position:relative;width:84px;border:1px solid #eceae526;border-radius:4px;background:#141619;color:#c9cbcf;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Hiragino Sans', 'Noto Sans JP', sans-serif;font-size:12px;transition:border-color 120ms ease-out,background-color 120ms ease-out;cursor:pointer} .ds-tile:hover{border-color:#464b53;background:#1b1d21} .ds-thumb{height:56px} .ds-info{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:4px;border-top:1px solid #eceae514;font-size:10px} .ds-info span{font-family:'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;color:#9a9ea5} .ds-tile-sel{border-color:#ffb020;background:#1b1d21;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #ffb020} .ds-tile-sel .ds-info{color:#eceae5} .ds-tile-sel::before,.ds-tile-sel::after{content:'';position:absolute;width:8px;height:8px;border:0 solid #ffb020} .ds-tile-sel::before{top:-1px;left:-1px;border-top-width:2px;border-left-width:2px} .ds-tile-sel::after{right:-1px;bottom:-1px;border-right-width:2px;border-bottom-width:2px} .ds-tile:focus-visible{outline:1px solid #ffb020;outline-offset:1px}

narrative.overview:
The stage is the picture; everything around it is on-screen display laid over black glass. Chrome reads like a field monitor's OSD: a thin status strip across the top, measurements set in tabular mono on a fixed-width graticule, hairline rules instead of panels-on-panels, and one warm marker colour that says "this is the selected thing". The creator spends long sessions in dim rooms beside other video tools, so the surround is dark, low-chroma and quiet, and the picture is always the brightest, most saturated object in view (along with the block categories, which keep their Scratch colours).

Density is instrument-grade: 28px controls, 10–13px type, 4px corners. Nothing is rounded, pastel or tabbed-folder; nothing is a generic grey NLE panel either. Every grey comes from one 11-step zone ramp, and state is spoken in exactly two chromatic voices: amber for selected/active/playing, REC red for rendering. The OSD strip and drop-down menus stay black glass in both themes; the light theme re-maps the zone ramp to paper and is selectable, but dark is the default and the reference.
keyCharacteristics: One 11-step neutral zone ramp (glass to paper) is the only source of grey.
Amber marks selection, the active page, focus, and play/run; REC red marks rendering only.
Hairline 1px rules at low alpha; 2–4px corners; tonal layering over shadow.
Platform tabular mono for every number (timecode, fps, resolution, counts, zoom); the platform UI face for labels.
Corner brackets mark selection, the way a monitor marks a focus area.
A 40px OSD strip on top, a 76px vertical page rail on the left, and a transport with one lit key.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every grey is a zone step (or a paper-white rule alpha). If a neutral is not on the ramp, it is drift.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Amber means selected, focused, active or playing. REC red means rendering. Neither is decoration, and neither borrows the other's meaning.

rules.name: The Dark Ink On Amber Rule
rules.body: Anything placed on amber is set in Amber Ink; white-on-amber fails.

rules.name: The Graticule Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change is set in `--font-mono` with `tabular-nums`, so readouts never jitter.

rules.name: The Status-Word Rule
rules.body: Tracked uppercase belongs only to OSD status words and units. Labels, headings and section names stay in sentence case in the UI face.

rules.name: The Flat Glass Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest are flat and separated by tone and hairlines. Only floating layers cast shadow.

dos: Do take every neutral from the zone ramp (`--zone-0` … `--zone-10`) or the paper-white rule alphas (`--rule` 8%, `--rule-strong` 15%, `--osd-rule` 12%).
Do mark the selected, focused, active or playing thing in amber, and set any ink on amber in Amber Ink (#1a1200).
Do set every changing number in `--font-mono` with `tabular-nums`, and every clock as SMPTE `HH:MM:SS:FF` via `src/lib/timecode.js`.
Do use 1px hairlines and 4px corners (`--radius-m`) for controls, fields, tiles, panels, menus and modals.
Do mark selection with the two-corner amber bracket (2px stroke, 7–8px arms) on rail pages and asset tiles.
Do keep the OSD strip and menus black glass in both themes.
Do keep transitions to colour and opacity, 120ms ease-out (160ms for tally changes), and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't use REC red for anything but rendering; errors use Fault Orange.
Don't re-tint block category colours; they stay the Scratch palette.
Don't use tracked uppercase for labels, headings or section names; it is reserved for OSD status words and units.
Don't draw corner brackets as decoration; they appear only on selection. Never draw guides or marks over the stage picture.
Don't give resting layout surfaces a shadow, or lift a selected item; selection is amber ring and brackets.
Don't round beyond 4px on rectangular UI or use pill buttons; circles are reserved for status lamps.
Don't colour rail or paint-toolbar glyphs; they are monochrome instrumentation.
